speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to your consultation. I understand you are presenting with fever and abdominal tenderness after giving birth; have you experienced any pain during urination, foul-smelling vaginal discharge, or severe headaches with vision changes? How many weeks postpartum are you?

speaker: Patient
text: 24-year-old woman. The patient is in the postpartum period after delivering an 11 pound boy vaginally at 40 weeks gestation. She experienced a prolonged course during labor. She reports increased frequency of urination and uterine tenderness. She also mentions a decrease in bowel sounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Uterine Atony leading to postpartum hemorrhage and subsequent sepsis.
